# Core Orders, manual order modal (census #53-#57; C4 buildNodeOptionsHTML, C5 mo-payload,
# C6 stagedSourceChanged). static/pages/orders.js run as served; the plant is the fixture.
# Option lines are "value" | label, under their <optgroup>.

== open the modal (the three reads answer)
  GET /api/nodes
  GET /api/payloads/templates
  GET /api/bins/available
  modal: show manual-order-modal
mo-source, the node list (C4):
  "" | — select —
  [Other]
    "_ROBOT:AMR-01" | _ROBOT:AMR-01  · group
    "_TRANSIT" | _TRANSIT  · group
    "GRP-A" | GRP-A  · group
    "SPOT-9" | SPOT-9
    "VIRT-1" | VIRT-1  · group
  [ZONE-2]
    "GRP-B" | GRP-B  · group
    "GRP-B-N1" |   ↳ GRP-B-N1
    "GRP-B-N2" |   ↳ GRP-B-N2
    "LINE-1" | LINE-1
mo-delivery: the same list
mo-staged-source: the same list
mo-staged-staging: the same list
mo-staged-delivery: the same list
mo-moverobot-dest: the same list
Pinned as is: census #6, GRP-A (a group of lanes) is under Other; its lane and slots and
GRP-OFF-N1 (member of a disabled group) are not offered at all; _TRANSIT, _ROBOT:AMR-01 and
VIRT-1 are offered as "group"; the disabled OLD-SLOT and GRP-OFF are left out.
mo-payload (C5, /api/payloads/templates in its order, whole catalog):
  "" | — none —
  "PART-B" | PART-B — Part B
  "PART-A" | PART-A — Part A
  "PART-C" | PART-C — Part C
mo-bin (Retrieve specific, /api/bins/available):
  "" | — select bin —
  [ZONE-1]
    "BIN-1" | BIN-1 @ GRP-A-L1-S1 (PART-A)
  [ZONE-2]
    "BIN-2" | BIN-2 @ GRP-B-N1 (PART-B)
    "BIN-3" | BIN-3 @ LINE-1
    "BIN-4" | BIN-4 @ GRP-B-N2 (PART-C)
    "BIN-5" | BIN-5 @ GRP-B-N2 (PART-C)
staged payload after the load: read-out: "Select a source node."

== close and open again
  (no request)
  modal: hide manual-order-modal
  modal: show manual-order-modal

== staged payload (C6) per source picked
  "GRP-A" -> picker: "" — any —, "PART-A" PART-A
  "GRP-B" -> picker: "" — any —, "PART-B" PART-B, "PART-C" PART-C
  "GRP-B-N1" -> read-out: "BIN-2 — PART-B"
  "GRP-B-N2" -> read-out: "2 bins at GRP-B-N2 — which one is picked is decided at dispatch."
  "LINE-1" -> read-out: "BIN-3 — empty"
  "SPOT-9" -> read-out: "No bin at SPOT-9."
  "_TRANSIT" -> read-out: "Nothing is parked in _TRANSIT right now."
  "VIRT-1" -> read-out: "Nothing is parked in VIRT-1 right now."
  "NOT-A-NODE" -> read-out: "Read from the bin at the source when the order is submitted."
  "" -> read-out: "Select a source node."
  (no request)

== the body each pick sends (an answer of 200)
-- transport move GRP-B-N1 -> LINE-1 (payload set, not sent)
  POST /api/orders/spot {"priority":0,"description":"","order_type":"move","source_node":"GRP-B-N1","delivery_node":"LINE-1"}
  timers: 1200 ms
  mo-status "Order #41 created (dispatched)" color var(--success); submit button disabled
-- transport retrieve PART-A x3 to LINE-1 (source not sent)
  POST /api/orders/spot {"priority":0,"description":"","order_type":"retrieve","delivery_node":"LINE-1","payload_code":"PART-A","quantity":3}
  timers: 1200 ms
  mo-status "Order #41 created (dispatched)" color var(--success); submit button disabled
-- transport retrieve_empty to the group GRP-B, no payload
  POST /api/orders/spot {"priority":0,"description":"","order_type":"retrieve_empty","delivery_node":"GRP-B","payload_code":""}
  timers: 1200 ms
  mo-status "Order #41 created (dispatched)" color var(--success); submit button disabled
-- transport retrieve_specific BIN-1 to _TRANSIT (offered, so sendable)
  POST /api/orders/spot {"priority":0,"description":"","order_type":"retrieve_specific","bin_label":"BIN-1","delivery_node":"_TRANSIT"}
  timers: 1200 ms
  mo-status "Order #41 created (dispatched)" color var(--success); submit button disabled
-- transport move with no source
  (no request)
  mo-status "Source node is required" color var(--danger); submit button enabled
-- staged from the group GRP-B, payload PART-C picked
  POST /api/orders/spot {"priority":0,"description":"","order_type":"staged","source_node":"GRP-B","staging_node":"SPOT-9","delivery_node":"LINE-1","payload_code":"PART-C"}
  timers: 1200 ms
  mo-status "Order #41 created (dispatched)" color var(--success); submit button disabled
-- staged from the node LINE-1 (no payload sent)
  POST /api/orders/spot {"priority":0,"description":"","order_type":"staged","source_node":"LINE-1","staging_node":"SPOT-9","delivery_node":"GRP-B-N1"}
  timers: 1200 ms
  mo-status "Order #41 created (dispatched)" color var(--success); submit button disabled
-- staged with no staging node
  (no request)
  mo-status "Staging node is required" color var(--danger); submit button enabled
-- move robot to VIRT-1
  POST /api/robots/move {"delivery_node":"VIRT-1","priority":0}
  mo-status "Robot sent to LINE-1" color var(--success); submit button enabled
-- move robot, nothing picked
  (no request)
  mo-status "Destination node is required" color var(--danger); submit button enabled

== refusals: staged from LINE-1 (the handler's own 400 shape)
-- orders.spot.400: 400 "{\"error\":\"source node is required for staged orders\"}"
  POST /api/orders/spot {"priority":0,"description":"","order_type":"staged","source_node":"LINE-1","staging_node":"SPOT-9","delivery_node":"GRP-B-N1"}
  console.error submitManualOrder source node is required for staged orders
  mo-status "source node is required for staged orders" color var(--danger); submit button enabled

== refusals: transport move GRP-B-N1 -> LINE-1
-- json.400: 400 "{\"error\":\"refused: the service's sentence\"}"
  POST /api/orders/spot {"priority":0,"description":"","order_type":"move","source_node":"GRP-B-N1","delivery_node":"LINE-1"}
  console.error submitManualOrder refused: the service's sentence
  mo-status "refused: the service's sentence" color var(--danger); submit button enabled
-- auth.401: 401 "{\"error\":\"unauthorized\"}"
  POST /api/orders/spot {"priority":0,"description":"","order_type":"move","source_node":"GRP-B-N1","delivery_node":"LINE-1"}
  console.error submitManualOrder Signed out
  mo-status "Signed out" color var(--danger); submit button enabled
-- json.500: 500 "{\"error\":\"failed: the store's error\"}"
  POST /api/orders/spot {"priority":0,"description":"","order_type":"move","source_node":"GRP-B-N1","delivery_node":"LINE-1"}
  console.error submitManualOrder failed: the store's error
  mo-status "failed: the store's error" color var(--danger); submit button enabled
-- proxy.502: 502 "<html><body>502 Bad Gateway</body></html>"
  POST /api/orders/spot {"priority":0,"description":"","order_type":"move","source_node":"GRP-B-N1","delivery_node":"LINE-1"}
  console.error submitManualOrder Server error (502)
  mo-status "Server error (502)" color var(--danger); submit button enabled
-- fetch rejects (TypeError: Failed to fetch)
  POST /api/orders/spot {"priority":0,"description":"","order_type":"move","source_node":"GRP-B-N1","delivery_node":"LINE-1"}
  console.error submitManualOrder No answer from the server
  mo-status "No answer from the server" color var(--danger); submit button enabled

== refusals: move robot to VIRT-1
-- robots.move.400: 400 "{\"error\":\"destination node is required\"}"
  POST /api/robots/move {"delivery_node":"VIRT-1","priority":0}
  console.error moveRobot destination node is required
  mo-status "destination node is required" color var(--danger); submit button enabled
-- json.500: 500 "{\"error\":\"failed: the store's error\"}"
  POST /api/robots/move {"delivery_node":"VIRT-1","priority":0}
  console.error moveRobot failed: the store's error
  mo-status "failed: the store's error" color var(--danger); submit button enabled
-- fetch rejects (TypeError: Failed to fetch)
  POST /api/robots/move {"delivery_node":"VIRT-1","priority":0}
  console.error moveRobot No answer from the server
  mo-status "No answer from the server" color var(--danger); submit button enabled
